meta.title: HarnessAMS
meta.description: HarnessAMS top-level plugin: three-tier UI (global console page over /harnessams APIs, project = DSH workspace, per-project task sidebar) plus remote machines over @linxin666/dsh-ssh, per-project health checks, disk usage, digital assets, the generic remote batch channel (batch_submit/batch_poll/batch_fetch) and the simulator-agnostic analysis tools (collect/progress/report/trash)
